name: Ivy Cosmetics Corporation
summary: Ivy Cosmetics Corporation makes and distributes cosmetic products and beauty supplements. Its catalog includes skincare such as beauty liquids, lotions, emulsions, creams and cleansers, plus special care treatments, makeup, hair and body care, health foods and equipment, and UV protection items. Originally Shirogane Corporation, it adopted its present name in October 1977 and has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
